assertions: Read project-structure-reference.md in the project-reference docs root for project tech stack and architecture
Backend: Use service-specific repositories - see backend-patterns-reference.md in the project-reference docs root
Backend: Use project validation fluent API - see backend-patterns-reference.md in the project-reference docs root
Backend: Side effects go in Entity Event Handlers (UseCaseEvents/) - never in command handlers
Backend: DTOs own mapping - see backend-patterns-reference.md in the project-reference docs root
Backend: Command + Result + Handler in ONE file under UseCaseCommands/{Feature}/
Backend: Cross-service communication via message bus only - never direct database access
Frontend: Extend project component base classes - see frontend-patterns-reference.md in the project-reference docs root
Frontend: Use project state management - see frontend-patterns-reference.md in the project-reference docs root
Frontend: Extend project API service base for HTTP calls - see frontend-patterns-reference.md in the project-reference docs root
Frontend: Always use .pipe(this.untilDestroyed()) for subscriptions - never manual unsubscribe
Frontend: All template elements must have BEM classes (block__element --modifier)
Architecture: Search for existing implementations before creating new code
Architecture: Place logic in LOWEST layer (Entity > Service > Component) to enable reuse
Architecture: Plan before implementing non-trivial tasks

portability.rule: Reusable skills and protocol text stay project-neutral; project-specific conventions are discovered from docs/project-config.json and docs/project-reference/.

backend-developer.contextPrefix: Focus: Backend CQRS development. Read backend-patterns-reference.md in the project-reference docs root for patterns.

integration-tester.contextPrefix: Focus: Integration tests. Read integration-test-reference.md in the project-reference docs root for patterns. Use TC-{FEATURE}-{NNN} format.

researcher.contextPrefix: Focus: Technology research. Check codebase for existing implementations first.
